IN RE: COMMONWEALTH TELEPHONE COMPANY LLC
PETITION FOR Review of Refund for Gross Receipts Interstate
Telephone
PERIOD(S) 12/31/2009
AND NOW, May 20, 2014, pursuant to the Fiscal Code, the Act of 1929, April 9, P.L. 343,
as amended, (72 P.S. § 1 et seq), the Board of Finance and Revenue of the Commonwealth of
Pennsylvania, based upon the reasons set forth herein, hereby ORDERS the following:
Jurisdiction
This petition comes before the Board of Finance and Revenue pursuant to Section 2704
of the Tax Reform Code of 1971, as amended, 72 P.S. § 9704.
Facts and Issues
The facts and issues presented in the instant petition are similar to those presented at
Docket No. 1310191, currently before the Board of Finance and Revenue, except that the
instant review petition concerns interstate gross receipts tax for the year ended December 31,
2009. For the reasons more fully set forth in the prior case, Petitioner’s request for relief is
denied.
Accordingly, this Board enters the following order:
Mailed: REED SMITH LLP on May 23, 2014
